name: account-password-change-racing-disable

graded_by.test: owed: Provider pauses own change after proving current hash A, commits competing disable, then resumes own change. Its state check and write are in one bbolt write transaction and cannot overwrite the voided hash. Account remains disabled with empty hash; no successful password-change audit. Exercise opposite ordering with change committed then disabled.
